projects.title: Self-Erecting Inverted Rotary Pendulum
projects.description: This project was conducted for a robotics course. The objective of this project was to cause a rotary pendulum to swing up and self-balance.

projects.title: Brain-Computer Interface Project
projects.description: The objective of this project is to move a robot by clenching one's fist. I wrote a MATLAB script reading data from an EEG headset to determine the robot's movement.
